verdict.rationale: Aircall's first-party developer docs include a guide to creating a webhook and listening to Aircall events, plus a dedicated guide to tracking SMS activity with messaging webhooks. The API reference confirms webhooks are a versioned product surface with v2-suffixed event names. Missing for 10: an explicit catalogue of call event types, details on delivery (retries, signature verification, payload schemas), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems

citations.quote: Beginner guide to create a Webhook and listen to Aircall events.
A guide to help you track Aircall SMS activity with messaging webhooks.
Aircall APIs and Webhooks are versioned to allow for continuous evolution and improvement while maintaining backward compatibility for existing integrations.
